file_change.purpose: Verify Core Design parsing, stable identities, dependency resolution, exact revision binding, and selected-statement addressing.
implementation: Create temporary valid and invalid Design Proposal fixtures in test code.
Assert malformed metadata headers, duplicate statements, unresolved dependencies, wrong statement ownership, and unresolved selected statements fail.
Assert exact revision binding is preserved as data and later Design content cannot silently replace the bound input.
Do not enforce deferred canonical section ordering, full header-shape quality rules, or semantic Design-quality automation in FS0-Core.
